summary: Combined focused Layer 1B searches: Expanded the direct public-company universe for the restaurant equipment/service/automation node. The cleanest reference anchor is Middleby, because its disclosed Commercial Foodservice segment is directly tied to QSR/full-service restaurant equipment. The underfollowed lane is more interesting in adjacent chokepoints: Pentair as a water/ice/filtration component supplier for beverage, coffee, fountain, ice and kitchen equipment uptime; Coca-Cola Consolidated as a beverage-route and fountain-equipment service node that screens as a bottler rather than restaurant infrastructure; and Serve Robotics as a speculative labor-saving automation platform tied to food delivery economics. This is research support only, not a buy/sell recommendation. Expanded the restaurant equipment/service/automation node with a two-lane universe. The reference anchor is Middleby, a direct commercial foodservice equipment supplier to QSR and full-service restaurants. The underfollowed lane emphasizes less obvious exposures: Farmer Brothers as a micro-cap coffee/beverage equipment service network, Westrock Coffee as a beverage-program and extract/cold-brew capacity supplier adjacent to dispensing demand, and Richtech Robotics as a speculative service-robotics automation candidate. The key chokepoint hypothesis remains that national uptime, field service, customer certification, and installed-base support may matter more than equipment manufacturing alone.
